narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Two and seven and six. That makes fifteen symbols, so it is fifteen.
<bookmark mark='size'/>A coil is worth a hundred strokes, so the symbols are not all equal.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Counting the symbols loses their values, so the answer must be much bigger.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble shows fifteen; the first numeral's symbols are counted one by one; then the coils grow big and the strokes stay small; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='back'/>To check, read each digit of your answer back as symbols.
<bookmark mark='match'/>Two hundred seventy six gives two coils, seven heels and six strokes, which matches.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; check lines: read the digits of the answer back as symbols; 276 is 2 coils, 7 heels, 6 strokes

old_misconception.wrong_answer: fifteen symbols, so it is fifteen
old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu counts the symbols: two, seven and six, fifteen symbols, so it is fifteen. Each kind of symbol has its own value, so the values must be added, not the symbols counted.
